about_the_game:
You awaken from a nightmare and Midgard is in chaos. Your simple way of life on your farm has been cut short and now you must fight to protect the ones you love, avenge the ones you lost and drive back the evil that plagues the lands of Midgard. With the kingdoms of Midgard teetering on the brink of annihilation, the old gods are silent, and hordes of undead Draugr now claw their way out of the shadows. You are now Midgard's last hope. Traverse sprawling darkwood forest, climb treacherous mountain peaks, and explore desolate coastlines. Unearth ancient ruins to discover the lore of the land and the dark secrets behind the Draugr plague spreading throughout Midgard!

  • Trade and Explore: Interact with NPCs, trade goods and discover countless secrets hidden across Midgard.

  • Open-world survival: Travel across the vast lands of Midgard and manage your hunger, thirst and stamina to survive. 

  • Brutal combat RPG: Challenging combat system that rewards skill points to learn new abilities.

short_description: Midgard is a single-player, unforgiving, action-RPG with a handcrafted open world steeped in Norse mythology. Encounter intense combat and level up your character's skill sets to fight your way across the kingdoms of Midgard. Save the people from evil as you trade, craft, hunt and fish to survive!
